description: Restart an automatic application that stopped — on an unanswered question, after repeated errors, or because the CV could not be tailored — or refresh one awaiting review so newly saved answers are reflected. Answer the open questions with answer_bank_save or screening_answers_set first. Refused for a declined attempt and for one that may already have reached the employer.
